mapper.select: SELECT sc.id, sc.product_id, p.name AS product_name, p.main_image AS product_image, p.price AS product_price, sc.quantity, sc.selected, p.status AS product_status, COALESCE(ps.stock, 0) AS stock, (p.price * sc.quantity) AS total_price FROM shopping_cart sc LEFT JOIN product p ON sc.product_id = p.id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN product_stock ps ON p.id = ps.product_id WHERE sc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC
